title: Pistachio Font
description: A simple pack that mixes up the font without straying too much from vanilla!
body:
![Pistachio Font on a book!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38d7bdd8906bcc690b17af11bc9b3893606f73b2.png)

Originally made for my modpack, Pistachio Font simply changes Minecraft's font to something a little less bland while staying close to the vanilla feel! Currently only changes the ASCII font file, but I may update the pack further in the future! :3
